part2.question: Describe a crowded place you went to

segments.v: I want to talk about Hoàn Kiếm Lake on New Year's Eve last year. There was a big countdown party there with music. I went there with my friends at about 9 pm. It was very crowded. There were thousands of people. We could not move easily. We listened to music, sang songs and took photos. At midnight, everyone counted down together and shouted “Happy New Year”. It was very exciting. But I also felt uncomfortable because there were too many people. I lost my friend for twenty minutes and I could not call her because the phone didn't work. Going home was also very difficult. I was happy to go there but I don't want to go again.

fluency.band6: Clear sequence, but general words (very crowded, uncomfortable).
fluency.band9: Setting → who and conditions → the crowd growing over time → the midnight moment → mixed feelings with reasons → decision for next time.

lexical.band9: jam-packed, shoulder to shoulder, inching, erupted, confetti, mixed, surged, claustrophobic, breathing room.

grammar.band9: Passive (It's held around the lake), participle clause (thinking that would be early enough), “without + V-ing”, and “The moment the countdown started, …”.

analysis.keyDifference: Band 6 says “very crowded” and “thousands of people”. Band 9 shows the crowd growing over time (By eleven…), uses precise crowd vocabulary, and gives mixed feelings with reasons.
